The '''Baragwin Ion-X weapon''' was an [[Ion rifle/Legends|ion rifle]] of an experimental [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] design that had been extensively modified by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Suvam Tan]]. The most significant alteration was the incorporation of a ''shaped-energy'' delivery system that delivered concussive force in addition to normal energy discharge.
